summary: No critical or high design defect. The frozen contracts already close the attacks that would otherwise block implementation. This is not the post-implementation gate, and security-report.json was not written.

backfilled.reason: This consultation was performed and delivered, and no artifact existed to record it: the framework had no artifact for a design-time specialist consultation, so the review survived only as a message. The consulting specialist did not write this file; it was reconstructed from that specialist's delivered output under explicit human authorisation, and it must not be read as evidence that the specialist wrote it.

binding_constraints.constraint: The 65536-byte cap must bound the READ, not only json.loads. Reject on Content-Length, or count chunks and stop at 65536, before buffering the whole stream.
binding_constraints.rationale: Starlette 1.0 request.body() buffers the entire stream first, so a check that runs after it never bounds memory. A multi-gigabyte POST can exhaust memory before the cap is consulted.

binding_constraints.constraint: Do not attach ShareCreate as a framework body parameter. Read the raw body in the route, then validate.
binding_constraints.rationale: FastAPI would validate before the route, skip the byte cap, and return 422 with a detail key echoing the submitted text, which breaks ADR-003 and discloses the share body in an error response.

binding_constraints.constraint: Application logging must stay on the exception class name. Do not log str(exc), the request line, the path, the body, or the id, and do not add request-logging middleware.
binding_constraints.rationale: The id is a bearer capability and the text is the sensitive payload. healthz and readyz must stay free of share fields.

binding_constraints.constraint: Keep the three bound-parameter statements only. Put text into the 200 body with a JSON encoder, never by splicing the stored string into a template.
binding_constraints.rationale: Bound parameters keep the text out of SQL; encoding at use keeps it out of injection into any response format.

binding_constraints.constraint: Do not add a rate limiter, quota, account lockout, encryption, custom token format, identity system, cache, or page shredder in this task.
binding_constraints.rationale: All are out of scope. Adding any of them inside implementation would be an undeclared scope expansion; they belong in a separate task if wanted.

non_blocking_notes.note: Rate limiting is accepted and out of scope. Unlimited POST can fill the local SQLite file. Residual risk is medium and the requirements already leave it out; 128-bit ids are why online guessing does not need a quota.
non_blocking_notes.evidence: Requirements out_of_scope lists rate limiting; design.json risks[].mitigation states the same.

non_blocking_notes.note: The 65536 cap must bound the read, not only json.loads (see SEC-C1). Local process denial only, not a high finding at this task's local-only scope.
non_blocking_notes.evidence: Starlette 1.0 request.body() buffers the stream before the route-level length check.

non_blocking_notes.note: An expired read may perform a best-effort delete while an unknown id will not, so response timing can differ. Low, and not an enumeration path at 128 bits. Do not add an expired status, and do not make delete of a missing id anything other than 204.
Plaintext SQLite and the id in the path are accepted. The path id is the capability the requirements chose; the file is the existing local database.
Delete does not shred pages. The row is gone; SQLite may leave bytes on disk until reuse. Accepted locally.

not_reviewed.item: Runtime behaviour, logs, and pinned dependencies
not_reviewed.reason: No handlers exist yet, so the app could not be run, logs inspected, or dependencies scanned for CVEs. No new package is introduced.

not_reviewed.item: Confirmation in code that the mint is secrets.token_urlsafe(16), the three statements stay parameterized, and error handlers do not echo the body or the id
not_reviewed.reason: That is the later security gate's job, against real code. AC-12 does not prove entropy.
